description: Hand-written, fully fictional call transcripts for telling genuine calls from scams on the SAME topic. 'pair' records come in twos (same topic and language, one legitimate, one scam), 'late_turn' records start like a genuine call and turn into a scam at caller turn scam_from_turn, 'benign' records are ordinary calls with no scam topic. Speakers: caller and persona (the decoy). No real person, account, UPI ID or phone number appears.
